purpose: post-hoc error analysis, no fitting, selection or threshold change
evaluation_role: already-inspected holdout retrospective diagnostic; not an independent new test

metric_definitions.false_positive_rate: FP / (FP + TN): fraction of on-time orders wrongly alerted
metric_definitions.false_discovery_rate: FP / (FP + TP): fraction of alerts that were false
metric_definitions.recall: TP / (TP + FN): fraction of delayed orders caught
metric_definitions.group_shares: share_of_period_orders and share_of_all_false_positives use all test orders/FP, including monthly groups
metric_definitions.intervals: Wilson 95% descriptive binomial intervals; seller/day correlation ignored

limitations: approved completed valid-timeline cohort only; excludes unresolved, cancelled and invalid orders
month is approval month; partial edge months are flagged
validation is maturity-purged and used to select this model/threshold
associations do not establish causes; groups overlap, so their FP counts cannot be added
many exploratory comparisons; small groups not reliable and no significance claim
delay_score is uncalibrated; score averages are not expected delivery probabilities
diagnostics must not be used to claim improvement on this already-inspected period

split.boundary_inclusion: Boundary dates belong entirely to the later split
split.label_maturity_policy: Training labels must be available strictly before validation boundary midnight; validation labels must be available strictly before test boundary midnight.

feature_and_outcome_summary.note: actual delivery is retrospective only; promise uses calendar days, actual uses fractional days
actual delivery is retrospective only; promise uses calendar days, actual uses fractional days
actual delivery is retrospective only; promise uses calendar days, actual uses fractional days
actual delivery is retrospective only; promise uses calendar days, actual uses fractional days

ranking_rules.high_fpr: filter sufficient_on_time_rows; sort FPR, check monthly consistency and denominators
ranking_rules.volume: sort FP count separately; no automated suppression or state-specific thresholds

standardized_full_months.method: pooled on-time state x promise-band weights, common strata only; no causal attribution

cohort_audit.interpretation: cohort inclusion, not true label coverage: cancellations and invalid timelines also excluded
cohort_audit.snapshot_limit: no extraction timestamp: right censoring cannot be measured from max observed delivery

false_positive_outcomes.note: observed outcome description only; days_early never used for prediction or rules
